visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black shirt, stands in a studio setting. Behind him is a large window or screen showing the Taipei night skyline with the lit Taipei 101 skyscraper. He speaks directly to the camera with a serious expression, using hand gestures to emphasize points. (2) A graphic of a scientific research paper titled 'Impacts of night market...' appears as a large rectangular overlay on the right side of the screen. The man continues his narration, pointing towards the text on the screen while the background remains the same night city view. (3) Small inset videos appear briefly: one showing a crowded night market at night with many people walking between stalls, and another showing a young boy looking through a window inside a house. Scientific charts and PM values are also displayed as digital overlays around the speaker. (4) The man concludes his talk, standing against the same nighttime city background. He gestures towards the camera with both hands as he gives final health advice. Traditional Chinese subtitles are consistently displayed at the bottom of the frame.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Subtitle]: 你們家附近有夜市嗎. [Slogan]: 夜市油煙 恐損鄰童肺部功能. (2) [Subtitle]: 以下這個消息請你注意了. 最近台灣中山大學與高雄醫學大學. (3) [Subtitle]: 發表在暴露科學與環境流行病學期刊上的研究表示. (4) [Variety]: PM 1, PM 2.5, PM 10. [Subtitle]: 像是 PM 1, PM 2.5, PM 10 等等 濃度明顯飆高. (5) [Subtitle]: 離夜市較近約略 600 公尺內 孩子的肺功能值明顯低於離夜市較遠的孩子. (6) [Subtitle]: 可以在夜市營業期間減少開窗通風 或是使用空氣清淨機. (7) [Subtitle]: 是該替附近的居民 特別是孩子 想想辦法了.
